name: Present simple passive
summary: Present simple passive (am/is/are + V3) fe'li ish-harakatni bajarmasdan, balki uning ustida bajarilishini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi. Bunda e'tibor harakatni kim qilganiga emas, balki kim yoki nima jabr ko'rgani yoki yaratilganiga qaratiladi.

usage.text: Doimiy takrorlanadigan yoki odatiy ishlarda, kim bajarishi muhim bo'lmaganda.

example.en: English is spoken all over the world.

usage.text: Buyumlar qayerda tayyorlanishi yoki o'stirilishini aytganda.

example.en: Cars are made in this factory.

example.uz: Bu yerda suratga olishga ruxsat berilmaydi.

example.en: The test is written by students.
The room is not cleaned every day.

structure.formula: Yes, Subject + am/is/are / No, Subject + aren't/isn't

example.en: Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

tip: Eslatma: Passive gaplarda asosiy fe'l doimo V3 (uchinchi shakl) yoki noto'g'ri fe'llarning uchinchi ustunidagi ko'rinishida bo'lishi shart!

name: Past simple passive
summary: Past simple passive (was/were + V3) o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan ish-harakatning kim tomonidan qilinganidan ko'ra, kim yoki nima ustida bajarilganiga urg'u berish uchun ishlatiladi.

usage.text: O'tmishda aniq vaqtda sodir bo'lgan ishlar haqida gapirganda.
Tarixiy voqealar, ixtirolar va asarlarni tasvirlashda.

example.en: The book was read by me.

structure.formula: Yes, Subject + was/were / No, Subject + wasn't/weren't

example.en: Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't.

tip: Eslatma: 'I', 'he', 'she', 'it' olmoshlari bilan 'was', qolgan ('we', 'you', 'they') olmoshlar bilan esa 'were' ishlatilishini unutmang.

name: by + agent and passive questions
name_uz: "by" yordamida bajaruvchini ko'rsatish va majhul nisbatdagi savollar
summary: Passive gaplarda ish-harakatni kim bajarganini ko'rsatish uchun 'by' so'zi ishlatiladi. Savol tuzganda esa yordamchi fe'l (am/is/are/was/were) egadan oldinga chiqariladi.

usage.text: Harakatni kim yoki nima bajarganini (agentni) aniq ko'rsatish zarur bo'lganda 'by' qo'shiladi.

example.en: This song was written by Ed Sheeran.
example.uz: Bu qo'shiq Ed Sheeran tomonidan yozilgan.

usage.text: Majhul nisbatda ma'lumot olish uchun savollar tuzishda.

structure.formula: Subject + to be + V3 + by + agent

example.en: The picture was painted by Picasso.

tip: Eslatma: Agar harakatni kim qilgani noma'lum bo'lsa yoki bu muhim emas deb topilsa, 'by + agent' qismini yozish shart emas.
